product_launches.description: Silverfin launched Talking Points, an in-platform capability that lets accounting firms capture and manage client advisory discussion points arising from routine compliance work, using AI-generated summaries and action items.

overview_description.description:
Silverfin is the cloud platform that makes accountants successful. It improves the efficiency, competitiveness and profitability of compliance services, and powers the development and delivery of advisory services.

Silverfin takes financial data directly from client systems and hosts it securely in a single cloud Structured Data Hub. Templates then standardise, and automate, accounting workflows and use the data hub to make compliance easy, fast, and accurate.

about_short_description.short_description: Silverfin is the cloud platform for automated financial reporting and value-added client advisory services.

product.name: Silverfin Platform
product.description: A cloud platform for accounting firms that centralizes client financial data and automates post-accounting, compliance, reporting, workflow, and collaboration processes.

product.name: Working Papers
product.description: Cloud-based working paper software that uses integrated client data, templates, and guided workflows to prepare, review, and complete accounting files.

product.name: Accounts Production
product.description: Cloud software for preparing and filing statutory financial accounts using data transferred from working papers and automated compliance workflows.

product.name: Corporation Tax
product.description: A tax workflow product that uses live working-paper data to populate corporation tax returns and schedules and supports efficient preparation and filing.

product.name: Insights
product.description: Portfolio-wide financial analysis for accounting firms, enabling teams to query client data, identify trends and risks, and support proactive advisory conversations.

product.name: Silverfin Assistant
product.description: An AI tool for accountants that analyzes client files, detects anomalies and compliance risks, explains findings, and suggests possible corrective actions.
